identity.name: Tradable: South American Consumer PoS Lender Senior Secured

about.description: A senior secured delayed-draw term loan to a South American consumer lender offering buy-now-pay-later financing at the point of sale, secured by its BNPL loan receivables and refinancing a warehouse facility. Issued through Tradable on ZKsync Era with cash interest in the 13-14.5% range.
about.registryInfo: Tradable Corp (not a registered investment adviser or broker-dealer), 150 N Riverside Plaza STE 5200, Chicago (offices of Victory Park Capital, a Janus Henderson company and seed investor; ParaFi invested Jan 2025). Each deal is a compliance-gated ERC-20 (country/investor-type/AML restrictions embedded); anonymized deal metadata pinned to IPFS; tokens minted on funding and burned pro-rata on principal repayment; USDC interest distributed pro-rata on-chain. Factory/registry contracts audited by Spearbit (Jul 2024) and Cantina (Oct 2024); KYC/KYB by Quadrata.
